```python
class Solution:
    def smallestFromLeaf(self, root: TreeNode) -> str:
        # Mapping of node values to characters
        char_map = {i: chr(i + ord('a')) for i in range(26)}
        
        # Initialize the global minimum string
        min_str = '~' * 8500  # Assuming maximum number of nodes is 8500
        
        def dfs(node, current_str):
            nonlocal min_str
            
            # If we reach a leaf node
            if not node.left and not node.right:
                # Add the current character to the end of the string
                current_str = char_map[node.val] + current_str
                # Update the global minimum string if necessary
                min_str = min(min_str, current_str)
            else:
                # If there's a left child, move to it
                if node.left:
                    dfs(node.left, char_map[node.val] + current_str)
                # If there's a right child, move to it
                if node.right:
                    dfs(node.right, char_map[node.val] + current_str)
        
        # Start DFS from the root
        dfs(root, '')
        return min_str
```
